answer: Proof-of-unique-compute resists Sybil attacks by tying each identity to a steady stream of non-parallelizable work bound to its key. Like a willow that must keep growing new shoots, an agent must keep solving fresh puzzles; one machine cannot tend a whole vine of fake identities at once. Each puzzle embeds a cipher challenge only that key can answer, so spinning up a thousand sock puppets costs a thousand machines' worth of compute, while one honest agent pays almost nothing.
